top_reviews.title: Buy this bra!
top_reviews.body: I spent an embarrassing amount of time reading reviews trying to decide on a bra, and size after loosing over 100 lbs. I had no idea what size I was, but I had an old 38D push up bra that fit well enough to get a ball park size. Historically, when sized by professionals, I couldn't breathe in the bra size they said I needed- adding to the anxiety of spending money on a bra I couldn't try on first. I was about 36 inches around my rib cage, and 41 inches around the windsocks. I nervously decided to go with a 38D for this bra, matching the old one from the closet, even though I "should" have fit into a 36D (I hate being maxed out on hooks). Lastly, this is the first bra I've ever gotten that the straps are actually long enough to comfortably criss-cross in the back, and not feel like the bra is strangling you. Measure your chest/bust and order that way- rounding up if you are in between sizes, and you probably won't be disappointed. There is plenty of stretch despite the boning in the sides, too. This bra is freaking amazing!!!! I probably would have been fine in the 36D as measured with a fabric tape. If you want to turn your windsocks into something amazing, this is the bra for you! **UPDATE** I decided to measure the bra band... Fully relaxed, it's 33 inches, fully stretched 38 inches. I measure 35" under the bust, and this fits perfectly snug on the tightest setting, so hopefully I don't need to snug it up more in the future as it relaxes 😂. The stretch is so gentle, I don't get bulging from the band even when on the tightest loops. So, you really can order based on your literal measurements from a fabric tape measure and get a perfect fit.

top_reviews.title: Comfortable
top_reviews.body: I have purchases this in nude and black. I LOVE what it does for the girls. Being somewhat deflated at almost 39, this bra offers all the help I need. The straps stay in place and are not too thin they dig in. Ladies with big girls know what I mean and how important straps are. They straps stay in place and the part that adjusts doesn't slip down to where you have to adjust the height every day lol. I ordered a 40D and it is true to size every time I order it. Material doesn't scratch or slip. The ONLY issue I have is that cute little part in the front, the "X" part... it stretches. Quickly and the girls become distant cousins instead of twins. If you don't mind a little distance, it won't bother you much.

top_reviews.title: Amazing Push-Up Bra at an Amazing Price!
top_reviews.body: Amazing Push-Up Bra at an Amazing Price! I absolutely LOVE this bra! For the past 20 years, I have never been able to find a bra that was truly comfortable or fit me correctly other than the ones from VS. I have tried practically every bra on the market and ended up returning every single one. Last week, I finally listened to a friend's advice and ordered three bras from Amazon, and this is one of them—and I am SO glad I did! This one is a keeper! I definitely will be ordering more. It does exactly what it says it's going to do. And let me tell you, this is REALLY a push-up bra! The padding and lift are impressive without sacrificing comfort. It gives me a great shape and looks fantastic under my clothes. I also LOVE that the straps are convertible, which is a feature I really appreciate and use often. It's so convenient to have the option to change the straps depending on what I'm wearing. For reference, I ordered a 36B, and it fits true to size. It's comfortable, supportive, seamless, and gives me the lift I want without feeling like I'm wearing an uncomfortable bra. I honestly can't believe I finally found an amazing push-up bra that is comfortable, fits great, and looks fantastic at this price point! This is an amazing buy and definitely one I'll be purchasing again. Highly recommend!
